parameters.name: ReferenceIds
parameters.description: The list of custom IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 20 IDs are supported.

parameters.name: VideoIds
parameters.description:
The list of video IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 20 IDs are supported. You can obtain video IDs by using the following methods:
- For videos uploaded through the console, log on to the [ApsaraVideo VOD console](https://vod.console.aliyun.com) and choose **Media Files** > **Audio/Video** to view the video ID.
- When you upload a video by calling the [CreateUploadVideo](~~55407~~) operation, the video ID is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
- After a video is uploaded, you can call the [SearchMedia](~~86044~~) operation to query the video ID, which is the value of the VideoId parameter in the response.
